ingredients.name_en: Pre-digested organic waste mixed with 30% cattle dung (a bed 1 m x 1 m x 0.5 m)
ingredients.name_hi: सड़ाया हुआ जैविक कचरा, 30% गोबर मिलाकर (1 मी x 1 मी x 0.5 मी की क्यारी)
सतह पर रहने वाले केंचुए (अफ़्रीकी, रेड वर्म या पेरियोनिक्स)

steps_en: Dry the cattle dung in the sun first (never use wet dung). Pre-digest other waste with cow dung for 20 days.
Mix the pre-digested waste with 30% cattle dung and fill the tub or bed (1 m x 1 m x 0.5 m).
Keep the moisture at 60%, sprinkling water over the bed rather than pouring it.
Spread 1 kg of worms (about 1000) evenly over the surface; they move in on their own.
Collect the castings from the top about once a week in a tub, or at the end in a small bed. Stop watering before harvest.
steps_hi: गोबर को पहले धूप में सुखा लें (गीले गोबर का उपयोग न करें)। अन्य कचरे को 20 दिन गोबर के साथ सड़ाएँ।
सड़े हुए कचरे में 30% गोबर मिलाकर टब या क्यारी (1 मी x 1 मी x 0.5 मी) भरें।
नमी 60% रखें; पानी डालने की जगह ऊपर से छिड़कें।
1 किलो केंचुए (लगभग 1000) सतह पर समान रूप से डालें; वे अपने आप अंदर चले जाते हैं।
टब में लगभग हर सप्ताह ऊपर की खाद निकालें, छोटी क्यारी में अंत में निकालें। कटाई से पहले पानी देना बंद करें।

ingredients.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
ingredients.quote: The predigested waste material should be mud with 30% cattle dung either by weight or volume. The mixed waste is placed into the tub / container upto brim.
ingredients.note: The waste volume (0.5 m³) is the bed volume below.

ingredients.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
ingredients.quote: For one-meter length, one-meter breadth and 0.5-meter height, 1 kg of worm (1000 Nos.) is required.
ingredients.note: Bed of 1 m x 1 m x 0.5 m = 1 m² of bed and 0.5 m³ of waste.

per_area_sqm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
per_area_sqm.quote: For one-meter length, one-meter breadth and 0.5-meter height, 1 kg of worm (1000 Nos.) is required.
per_area_sqm.note: The quantities are for a 1 m² bed.

steps_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
steps_en.quote: All other waste should be predigested with cow dung for twenty days before put into vermibed for composting.

steps_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
steps_en.quote: The moisture level should be maintained at 60%. Over this material, the selected earthworm is placed uniformly.

steps_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
steps_en.quote: If necessity arises, water should be sprinkled over the bed rather than pouring the water. Watering should be stopped before the harvest of vermicompost.

shelf_life_days.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
shelf_life_days.quote: Vermicompost can be stored for one year without loss of its quality, if the moisture is maintained at 40% level.

apply_method.title: TNAU Agritech Portal: vermicompost
apply_method.quote: A recommended rate of vermicompost application is 15-20 percent.
apply_method.note: Mixed into soil or potting mix at 15-20%.
